increment_paragraph: **EVENT-ORDERED-LIFETIME (2026-10-28).** The [card](../../reports/event-ordered-lifetime/README.md) adds bounded complete ordered register/remove/destroy/release traces and a separate, independently replayed cross-unit lifetime channel. Removal-only C helpers carry exact formal-index order through static same-unit calls or a selected external home; early release, wrong-holder poison, mixed effects, altered homes and supplied local inference remain refused. Schema 23 prevents older readers from silently treating the effect-bearing record as ordinary borrowed custody. Sixteen Lean theorem checks accompany the Rust controls. Source extraction, declared API semantics and model correspondence remain assumptions; whole-record holder frames, collector identity, conditional per-record loop correlation, derived path equality, threaded teardown, descriptors and automatic backend body proof remain open. All three native verdict vectors remain unchanged. Six already-Unknown system scheduler rows expose stricter diagnostics after removal-bearing helper effects are withheld from ordinary borrow publication.
